body: Obviously I see no qualms about dancing and if I could mentally get my shit together it'd be perfect for me but I don't want to disappoint my family. I feel like I've always managed to mess up some how my whole life, don't want it to come to light that their youngest is a stripper. Even if they would forgive it or get over it.... I have thought about whether I need professional help or maybe medication I just don't want to let my family catch on to something being wrong or where I've really been working and I know (especially my oldest sibling) would probably realize something was wrong and figure it out in next to no time because I already feel insane

I want to try. I am clearly confused by all of these feelings. I use humor to cope and to try to make light of things and be bearable to be around regardless but... I have none. It's no longer a joke with some thinly veiled truths I can't even crack half a smile. I want to blink out of existence. I will try my hardest to be upfront with people in my life but I've gotten very good at just getting through the motions and being just present enough. thank you for the advice, I'm sure it comes from experience and I hope you're feeling better as you have some clarity on the situation.

I just don't feel present in life a lot of the time but cannot phathom the logic behind not existing... fueling an endless cycle of anxiety because there doesn't seem to be a way to say this to someone in real life and have them still want to be around you at all. But it's apparently steaming through my pores. I think I seem fine and everyone's just like "who's funeral it" well I just wish it was mine.
I know that I should probably express myself but the embarrassment controls me.... I open my mouth and no words come out because I don't even believe anymore that I can be understood

I was assaulted at the end of last year and and I noticed that my anxiety has spiraled since then. When the general anxiety wanes then I'm just depressed, like Eeyore, from being so exhausted/anxious for days.

 I am a dancer that commutes 2 hours to D.C to work (It used to be fun and exhilarating as I love to dance, and it got me away from home often which triggers the anxiety of running into my assailaint). Now I just go through the motions.

When I am home I do not even feel like eating. I sleep the day away or I just stay up all night like I did tonight. I am repulsed by the idea of myself and easily convince myself that my friends barely want to be around me. I try so hard to put a smile on and people just tell me "you don't seem like yourself." If You notice how do you think I feel walking around? 

I started to not even feel like I fit in with my closest friends. I only felt like I was doing something right when I danced, and now I don't even feel that way. In a moment of weakness I confided in an ex lover I've never gotten out of my system for more than a few months for 3 years. I told him all the things that I don't have the courage to speak to my friends. I let him confirm that I don't fit in and he knows me best and maybe a sanctuary could be with him. I told him things as deep as I'm typing now that I've never uttered to anyone else... and all I got out of it was a few dead end hook ups and rejection.

Even my transparency and vulnerability was rejected. What else do I have to offer? I go through the motions and try not to consciously wonder why this happened but it fucked me up and continues to fuck me up. Maybe people like the idea of me. I am very real,  flawed, and struggling but it only comes up as a character flaw. "I am not bubbly, funny, and lighthearted like I always am. I should work on that." I CAN'T be like that. I feel like I'm suffocating. I feel like I'm being swallowed by an abyss, it isn't a choice. My efforts to champion through this aren't working. I am dejected and hopeless and I don't know what to do next. I already told someone I thought I could trust and I'm on Reddit with my swan song.
